description: This file defines the LinkManager class responsible for managing communication links (serial, TCP) for the rusefi engine control system. It handles connection establishment, threading, message processing, and state management within the IO module.

classes.name: LinkManager
classes.description: Manages communication links for the engine control system, including establishing connections, threading, and message parsing.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified port and waits until the connection is established or times out.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the connection based on the given port, setting up the appropriate connector.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the connection using the current connector, with optional connection state listener.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command string to the connected device.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a packet received from the device using the connector.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if the connector has encountered an error.

methods.name: unpackConfirmation
methods.description: Extracts confirmation message from incoming messages.

methods.name: getDefaultPort
methods.description: Returns the default communication port, typically the last available serial port.

methods.name: assertCommunicationThread
methods.description: Verifies if the current thread is the communication thread (currently disabled).
